responsibility: This file implements optional invocation of the external C preprocessor for mc source files. It builds the command line from mcOptions, creates and tracks temporary output files, runs the host preprocessor, reports failures, and registers a termination cleanup routine that unlinks generated temporaries. It is the preprocessing stage wrapper used by mcComp before source lexing begins.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file contains the working preprocessing wrapper for mcPreprocess, including temp-file naming, command assembly from mcOptions, system() invocation, and exit-time deletion of generated files. The sibling mcPreprocess.def only declares preprocessModule.
